subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should doctor intentionally stop automatic root-memory migration above 8 MiB and require manual repair while leaving both files untouched?
rationale: The cap prevents unbounded memory use but changes a shipped migration path for existing large workspaces, so repository evidence cannot determine the acceptable compatibility boundary by itself.

options.title: Accept bounded safe skip
options.body: Approve the 8 MiB ceiling and no-mutation behavior after a fresh current-head terminal transcript proves normal merge and both oversized directions.

options.title: Support larger migrations
options.body: Require a streaming or otherwise bounded migration design that can preserve automatic repair for root-memory files larger than 8 MiB.

options.title: Pause the hardening
options.body: Keep the current unbounded path until maintainers choose a supported size limit and recovery experience.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded safe skip
recommendation.body: Approve the 8 MiB ceiling and no-mutation behavior after a fresh current-head terminal transcript proves normal merge and both oversized directions.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly associates this person with the memory area, and the unresolved choice governs durable-memory migration behavior.
